about.description: Quantoz issues a fiat-backed stablecoin maintained at parity with its reference currency through reserve backing and redemption mechanisms. It enables fast, low-cost settlement of stablecoin transactions.
about.registryInfo: Quantoz Payments BV (Netherlands; DNB-licensed Electronic Money Institution under MiCA). Issuer of EURQ (Euro stablecoin) and USDQ (USD stablecoin) under EU MiCA / Dutch EMI regulation. Founded 2010 (originally as a Bitcoin payments processor).

fees.revenueNotes: Quantoz earns float income on stablecoin reserves and platform/transaction fees from MiCA-compliant payment-services activity built on EURQ/USDQ rails.
